measured: Published API list prices in US dollars per million tokens. input, cache_read and cache_write mirror cache-guard's prices() for a five-minute cache write (input x 1.25), and a test fails when they disagree; output is the published output price. Families are matched in this order against the model id reduced to lowercase letters and digits, the first match winning, so a generation priced on its own comes before its family. Checked: a Haiku subagent's request of 26 input, 449 output, 41957 cache-read and 9601 cache-write tokens prices at $0.018468 here, and the session's own cost figure rose by $0.01847.
